Answers
art_density: 64 px per cell for everything standing on the ground: buildings, resource nodes, trees, props, NPCs and creatures; ground and coast tiles stay 32. Start with a 3-building pilot (Paper Mill, Kiln, Workbench) that you check in game first
font_read: All of them as a player choice in Menu > Settings ("Text font": Pixelify only, Pixelify titles + Jersey 10, Jersey 10 only, VT323, Smooth); the game starts on Pixelify titles + Jersey 10  | note: Press start P2 looks good

interpretation.art_density: PPU 64 for all standing objects (buildings, nodes, trees, props, NPCs, creatures); ground + coast tiles stay 32. Pilot first: Paper Mill, Kiln, Workbench, checked in game before the rest.
interpretation.font_read: Menu > Settings 'Text font' with every option, default Pixelify titles + Jersey 10. Note: Press Start 2P looks good, so it is added as one more choice in the setting.
